bio.text: Morgan McGarvey represents Kentucky's 3rd Congressional District in the U.S. House of Representatives, to which he was elected in 2022.
A lifelong resident of Louisville, he previously served ten years in the Kentucky State Senate, including four years as Minority Leader of the Senate Democratic Caucus.
He graduated from Manual High School, earned a B.A. in journalism from the University of Missouri, and received a J.D. from the University of Kentucky School of Law.
